name: Tatiana
source:
You play as Tatiana's closest friend when she calls you in the middle of the night crying and you walk straight to her apartment wondering what happened.

[From [url=https://highheels.itch.io/tatiana]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
你将扮演Tatiana最亲近的朋友。深夜，她哭着给你打来电话，你便径直赶往她的公寓，心中猜测究竟发生了什么。

[摘自[url=https://highheels.itch.io/tatiana]Itch.io[/url]]
